verdict_rationale: The agent scores 3040/4000 (76%). Core arithmetic and bank statement reconciliation are accurate. Overdue detection, unmatched-item isolation, and reason-code coverage are strong. The output falls short of 'Pass' on three grounds: (1) cross-sheet data propagation failures — partial payments flagged in the Bank sheet are not carried through to the Invoice/Bills sheets, creating an inconsistent picture across the workbook; (2) two status field errors (BILL-405, BILL-407 showing 'Unpaid' for confirmed payments) that would misdirect a finance team; and (3) absence of a dedicated unmatched-items view and audit-grade page/line number citations. Addressing these three areas would likely push the score to the 'Pass' threshold.
